articles.title: Hornbeck Announces New Employee Inducement Grant Under NYSE Rule 303A.08
articles.summary: Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. (the "Company") (NYSE: HOS), a premier integrated offshore services company, today announced that in connection with the merger between the Company and Helix Energy Solutions Group, Inc., the Company granted Todd M. Hornbeck a performance-based equity award covering up to 1,500,000 shares of common stock under the Hornbeck Offshore Services, Inc. 2026 Omnibus Inducement Incentive Plan (the "Inducement Grant").
